label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
text: Where has our WALLY gone?\pWe have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN\nvery soon…$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
text:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?\pDo you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?\pThey first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
text: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
text: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it\nwhenever you're looking for a GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
text: My face is reflected in the water.\pIt's a shining grin full of hope…\pOr it could be a look of somber silence\nstruggling with fear…\pWhat do you see reflected in your face?$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
text: Let's say you have six POKéMON.\nIf you catch another one…\pIt is automatically sent to a STORAGE\nBOX over a PC connection.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: NORMAN\l“A man in pursuit of power!”$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
text: PETALBURG CITY\n“Where people mingle with nature.”$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
text: WALLY'S HOUSE$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
text: Excuse me!\pLet me guess, from the way you're\ndressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
text: … … … … … …\pWell, maybe not.\nYour clothes aren't all that dirty.\pYou're either a rookie TRAINER,\nor maybe you're just an ordinary kid.$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
text: I'm roaming the land in search of\ntalented TRAINERS.\pI'm sorry to have taken your time.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
text:
DAD: Hm?\pWell, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
So you're all finished moving in?\pI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\pOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\pHm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.\pThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokemon
text: Um… I…\nI'd like to get a POKéMON, please…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRight
text: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
text:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\pI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\pBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHmISee
text: DAD: Hm. I see.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that,\nright?\pGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
text: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\pWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
text: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\pDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\pWALLY received a POKé BALL!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyOhWowThankYou
text: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nThank you!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyComeWithMe
text: {PLAYER}… Would you really come\nwith me?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut
text: DAD: So, did it work out?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
text:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\p{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.\pYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\pI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\pOh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!\pBye, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
text:
DAD: Now…\p{PLAYER}, if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\pHead west to ROUTE 104, then north
through PETALBURG WOODS to RUSTBORO.\pThere, you should challenge
the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.\pAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\pCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\pOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.\pBut that's only after you become
stronger.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
text:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\pFollow ROUTE 104 west of town, then
head north through PETALBURG WOODS.\pThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\p{PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\pI'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
text:
DAD: I see… So, you've beaten
the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\pBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\pYou should go challenge him.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
text: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten\nstronger.\pI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NextGymMauville
text: WATTSON runs MAUVILLE GYM. From\nSLATEPORT, follow ROUTE 110 north.\pKeep going. Bring back four BADGES,\nand we'll see how far you've come.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NextGymLavaridge
text:
FLANNERY runs LAVARIDGE GYM, below
MT. CHIMNEY. Travel north of MAUVILLE.\pThe cable car is on ROUTE 112. From
the summit, JAGGED PASS leads down.\pEarn that fourth BADGE, then come home.
I'll be waiting here at the GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
text:
DAD: Four BADGES already… I still
remember you setting out from\lLITTLEROOT.\pI'm proud of you, {PLAYER}. But
here in the GYM, I have to give\levery challenger my best.\pShow me how far you and your
POKéMON have come!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
text: You beat the team I've raised\nwith so much care.\pI'm proud of you.\nTake the BALANCE BADGE.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE\nfrom DAD!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
text:
DAD: The BALANCE BADGE lets your
LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 55.\pIt also lets POKéMON use SURF to
travel over water.\pThis is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainLopunnite
text: Dad: Lopunnite lets Lopunny Mega\nEvolve. Let it hold the stone in\lbattle.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
text: DAD: As a LEADER, I learned from you.\nAs your father, I'm simply proud.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pPlease come with me.\nI have something I want you to have.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
text: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?\pLet me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for\na minute or two.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
text:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.\pI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\pIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
text: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?\pThe world of POKéMON is deep.\pI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Welcome, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}!\pDefeat the Trainers in a room to
open its onward doors.\pThe left door leads to the
MULTIHIT ROOM. The right leads to\lthe RETALIATION ROOM.\pEach room's sign names its plan.
Choose your route and prepare your\lpartners together.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\pLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
text: This is the MULTIHIT ROOM.\pOne attack can strike again and\nagain. A FOCUS SASH may not be\lenough!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
text: That was a magnificent battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
text: Another challenge waits ahead.\pThe left door leads to the TRICK\nROOM; the right leads to the\lSTATUS ROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
text: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\ltraining yourself and your POKéMON.\pThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
text: Welcome to the TRICK ROOM.\pLICKILICKY shakes the ground.\nORANGURU tells it to do it again.\pTELEPATHY keeps my partner safe.\nWhat will keep yours safe?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
text: Our timing was not enough. Good\nbattle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
text: WIDE GUARD can stop both EARTHQUAKES.\nBut we have single-target moves, too.\pThe POWER ROOM is next. Be ready!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
text: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
text: This is the ENDURANCE ROOM.\pHealing buys time. DUBWOOL can\nturn that time into BODY PRESS\lpower.\pCan your team finish the job?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
text: We could not outlast your team!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
text: That was well played.\pThe next door leads to the BURST\nROOM. Be ready for its\lconcentrated pressure.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
text: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
text: This is the BURST ROOM.\pEXPLOUD's voice can hit Ghosts.\nMEGA GLALIE turns Normal attacks\linto Ice.\pPrepare for both sides of the\nboard!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
text: Your team took the battle!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
text: A strong pair can attack through\ndifferent defenses.\pThe last reserves still matter:\nSTOUTLAND and KANGASKHAN keep the\lpressure on.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
text: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\lbecome a lot tougher.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
text: This is the RETALIATION ROOM.\pDRAMPA can gain power after a\nhard hit. RUFFLET's HUSTLE trades\laccuracy for strength.\pEvery risk needs a purpose!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
text: You were a cut above me…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
text: More formidable teams await.\pThe left door leads to the STATUS\nROOM; the right leads to the\lENDURANCE ROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
text: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\pWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
text: This is the STATUS ROOM.\pZANGOOSE and URSARING make their\nown status a weapon.\pBring a plan for the whole team!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
text: Our defenses weren't enough…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
text: You've given me something to think\nabout.\pThe left door leads to the POWER\nROOM; the right leads to the BURST\lROOM.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
text: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
text: This is the POWER ROOM.\pOur LEADER told us to give you\neverything we have, even if you\lare his kid.\pThat is exactly what we will do!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
text: But… I went all out!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
text: The way you use your POKéMON…\nIt's like your father's style.\pGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
text: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\pBut what decides the winner?\pWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have\nfor their POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
text: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
text: “MULTIHIT ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
text: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
text: “RETALIATION ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
text: “TRICK ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
text: “STATUS ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
text: “ENDURANCE ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
text: “POWER ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
text: “BURST ROOM”, the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
text: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\p“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\pNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
text: Traveling is wonderful!\pWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
text:
Sigh…\pI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…\pCrawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…\pCross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…\pAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…\pIt must be fabulous to travel!$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
text: NORMAN became our town's new\nGYM LEADER.\pI think he called his family over from\nsomewhere far away.$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
text: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\pHow would I put it?\pI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
text: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\pThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
text: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\luseful when you're in a hurry.$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
text: Do you carry ANTIDOTES?\pPoison no longer drains HP while\nwalking, but it still matters in battle.\pAn ANTIDOTE clears it before your\nnext fight.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
text: That PC-based POKéMON Storage\nSystem…\pWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
text: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
text: There are many types of POKéMON.\pAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\pDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
text: For {STR_VAR_1}, remember:\pGRASS attacks are strong against\nWATER, GROUND, and ROCK types.\pA second type can change how much\ndamage an attack does.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
text: For {STR_VAR_1}, remember:\pFIRE attacks are strong against\nGRASS, BUG, ICE, and STEEL types.\pA second type can change how much\ndamage an attack does.$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
text: For {STR_VAR_1}, remember:\pWATER attacks are strong against\nFIRE, GROUND, and ROCK types.\pA second type can change how much\ndamage an attack does.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
text:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?\pThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\pHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\pWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\pThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\pWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\pI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
text: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.\pBut our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\pWe owe it all to you!\pWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\pI think that made WALLY really
happy.\pActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\pHappy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.\pThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
text:
A partner that can SURF will carry
you across water. Head to MAUVILLE.\pGo east onto ROUTE 118 and cross its
river, then take ROUTE 119 north.\pBeyond the WEATHER INSTITUTE lies
FORTREE CITY and WINONA's GYM.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
text: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
text: Oh? You met WALLY in\nEVER GRANDE CITY?\pOh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.\pHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\lthat all by himself.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
text: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\pIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
text:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…\pBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\pYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\pI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
text: Hmmm…\nNot a one to be found…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
text: Oh, hello! Have you seen a SHROOMISH\naround here? I've always loved them.\pI'm on my way back to DEVON in RUSTBORO.\nI thought I could spare a little time…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
text: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\lforever, didn't you?\pI got sick of waiting, so here I am!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
text: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\pHand over those papers!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
text: Please, help me!\pThese papers belong to DEVON. I can't\nlet him take them!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
text: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\pNo one who crosses TEAM AQUA\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\pCome on and battle me!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
text: You're kidding me! You're tough!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
text:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!\lCome on and battle me again!\pI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…\pAnd, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\pI'll let you go today!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
text: Whew… I thought he'd caught me.\nThank you for standing up to him.\pI must get these papers back to DEVON.\nBut first, take this GREAT BALL.\pIt's the least I can do!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
text: He said TEAM AQUA was after something\nin RUSTBORO, too, didn't he?\pMy colleagues could be in trouble.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
text: I need to warn everyone at DEVON.\nNo more looking for SHROOMISH today!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
text: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
text: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\pGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
text: I have all these POKéMON,\nbut I couldn't win…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
text: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
text: If you have a big BUG POKéMON,\npeople respect you for it.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
text: I want to tell you when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
text: I want to tell you when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
text: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
text: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\lSo, I've been training hard.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
text: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\lof tall grass.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
text:
BURMY hide among these leaves. Females
become WORMADAM at Lv. 20; males\lbecome MOTHIM at the same level.\pAfter a battle, BURMY makes a cloak
from its surroundings: leaves in grass,\lsand in caves, or trash in buildings.\pRaise DARTRIX to Lv. 34 or higher here
to get Hisuian DECIDUEYE. Elsewhere,\lit grows into the usual form.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
text: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\pYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TartAppleExplanation
text: It's a TART APPLE. Use it on\nAPPLIN to evolve it into FLAPPLE.\pFunny how the same POKéMON can\ngrow differently depending on its\lfavorite treat!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
text: TRAINER TIPS\pUse the LEVELER to bring a new partner\nto your current training limit.\pThen prepare its moves, Ability, Nature,\nand held item before the next battle.$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
text: FOREST FIELD NOTES\pCUT opens paths into the deeper\nforest. CELEBI lives in the\lthird area.\pVIRIZION and WO-CHIEN live in\nthe second area. Each of these\llegendaries has a 3% wild\lencounter chance in its habitat.$

label: PetalburgWoods_3_Text_Ranger
text: CELEBI has been slipping between\nthe trees. You can find it in\lthis grove's grass, with a 3%\lencounter chance.$

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMON hide in tall\ngrass like this, don't they?\pI've never thrown a POKé BALL. Watch me\nand tell me if I do it right.\p…Whoa!$

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
text: WALLY: I did it… It chose to stay.\nIt's my POKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
text: {PLAYER}, thank you! Let's go back to\nthe GYM. I want your dad to see!$

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
text: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\pThe grass goes up my nose and…\nFwafwafwafwafwa…\pFwatchoo!$

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
text: I thought I saw a flower move...\nThen a little green POKéMON ran\lthrough the grass!\pSHAYMIN! Right here, so close\nto home! It has a 3% chance of\lappearing in the grass.$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
text: ROUTE 102\n{RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
text: ROUTE 102\n{LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$

label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
text: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\pHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.$

label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
text: The sea, huh?\pI wonder what it's like at the bottom\nof the sea?$

label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
text: A weakened wild POKéMON is easier\nto catch. Sleep or paralysis can\lhelp, too.\pTake care with poison and burns.\nYou don't want it to faint before\lyour POKé BALL reaches it!$

label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
text: You're a thief if you try to steal\nsomeone else's POKéMON.\pYou should throw POKé BALLS only at\nwild POKéMON.$

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
text: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER. I'm\njust out for a walk.\pSome TRAINERS will challenge you\nas soon as they see you. Others\lwould rather stop and chat!$

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
text: I found this LEAF STONE beneath the\nflowers! Some GRASS POKéMON evolve\lwhen exposed to it. You should have it!$

label: Route104_Text_LeafStoneExplanation
text: That LEAF STONE can evolve certain\nGRASS POKéMON. Use it when ready.$

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
text: I found this Leaf Stone among the\nflowers. You should have it!$

label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
text: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?$

label: Route104_Text_MrBrineysCottage
text: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE$

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
text: ROUTE 104 {RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG\nCITY$

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignRustboro
text: ROUTE 104 {UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

label: Route104_Text_PrettyPetalFlowShop
text: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP$

label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
text: TRAINER TIPS\pTrainer battles in HOENN are\nDOUBLE BATTLES. Prepare your first\ltwo partners together.\pA good opening pair gives each\nPOKéMON room to do its job.$

label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pDEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with\nthe MATCH CALL system, huh?\pWe should register each other so we\ncan get in contact anytime.$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredMay
text: {PLAYER} registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex
text: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN},\nhow's your POKéDEX coming along?$

label: Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle
text: Mine's looking pretty decent.\nSo…\lHow about a little battle?$

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
text: MAY: Okay! We can battle when\nyou're ready.\pI've got plenty of POKéDEX notes\nto sort out in the meantime.$

label: Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle
text: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$

label: Route104_Text_MayIntro
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! We've both\nfound new partners since ROUTE\l103.\pShow me how your team works!$

label: Route104_Text_MayDefeat
text: Yikes! You read that faster than me!$

label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
text: MAY: We've both come a long way\nsince ROUTE 103!\pAre you sailing with MR. BRINEY?\nSay hello to PEEKO for me. I hope\lthe sea stays calm for you!$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pCool, you had DEVON install the MATCH\nCALL system on your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredBrendan
text: {PLAYER} registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?\nHave you filled in any pages yet?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
text: Me, I'm doing great!\pWant to check out how good I am with\na battle?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
text: BRENDAN: Got somewhere to be? All\nright. Come find me when you want\la battle!$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
text: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanIntro
text: BRENDAN: Ready, {PLAYER}? I've\nbeen looking forward to our next\lbattle!$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Hmm… Fine. You saw it coming.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
text: BRENDAN: You've been busy since\nROUTE 103. I'll have to keep up!\pYou're going out to sea with MR.\nBRINEY, right? Bring back a good\lstory. I'll have one for you, too.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko
text: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
text:
Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You saved my darling PEEKO!\lWe owe so much to you!\pWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\pHmhm…\pYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\pQuite the busy life you must lead!\pBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\pYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
text:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
text:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_EventScript_MegaGift_VENUSAURITE_Text
text: I found this while tending flowers.\nIt seems to answer a Venusaur.\pKeep gathering berries as you travel.\nThe Berry Master trades stones, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RoxanneRestoredBefore
text: Stone alone is not a strategy.\pStudy the partners in my GYM, then\nshow me how your own team connects.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RoxanneRestoredAfter
text: Your STONE BADGE proves you can solve\nmore than a type chart.\pDEVON may have a task for you next.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
text: The DEVON CORPORATION…\nWe all just shorten it to DEVON.\pThat company makes all sorts of\nconvenient products.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
text: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?\pCome to think of it, yes, a shady-\nlooking guy went around the corner.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
text: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM\nchallenge?\pWhen you get that shiny GYM BADGE\nin hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to\lrealize what is required of them.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
text: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!\pOut of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,\nRUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
text: Oh? Who might you be?\nYou're a new face around these parts.\pHave you just transferred into the\nPOKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
text: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…\pIt's not going to be easy winning with\nmy FIRE-type POKéMON…\pFIRE-type POKéMON don't match up\nwell against ROCK-type POKéMON…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
text: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in\na cottage by the sea.\pHe goes for walks in the tunnel every\nso often.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
text:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.\pHe said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.\pThat old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
text: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.\pWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with POKéMON, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!\pIf I go to this school, will I be able\nto catch rare POKéMON easily?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
text: If a POKéMON gains experience in\nbattles, it can sometimes change in\lthe way it looks.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
text: A POKéMON changes shape?\nIf one did that, I would be shocked!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
text: A POKéMON you get in a trade from\nsomeone grows fast.\pBut if you don't have certain GYM\nBADGES, it may not obey you…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay
text: Get out!\nOut of the way!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
text: Wait! Pleeeaaase!\pDon't take my GOODS!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
text:
Oh, it's you!\pYou're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!\pHelp me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!\pIf I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.\pHe ran east along ROUTE 116!
Please check RUSTURF TUNNEL.\pBring the GOODS back to me here.
I'll wait by the road.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffTowardsTunnel
text: Follow ROUTE 116 east to\nRUSTURF TUNNEL. He went that way!\pPlease bring the DEVON GOODS\nback to me here.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
text:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?\pYou did!
You got them back!\pYou really are a great TRAINER!\pI know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
text: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
text: Excuse me, please!\nPlease come with me!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other so we can\ncontact one another anytime!\p… … … … … …$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredMay
text: Registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
text:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!\pSo…
How about a little battle?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
text: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle
text: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose
text: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat
text: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
text: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who\nI just passed…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you\nmight not know this, but MR. BRINEY\lwas once a revered seafarer.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV! Cool!\pLet's register each other so we can\nget in touch anytime!\p… … … … … …$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredBrendan
text: Registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
text:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\p{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?\pMine rules.\pWant to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInPokemon
text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle
text: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy
text: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
text: BRENDAN: By the way, you know\nMR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?\pI bet you didn't know this, since you\njust moved here, {PLAYER}, but\lMR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
text: “Timesaving tunnel nearing\ncompletion!”\p…Is what it says on the sign, but\nthere's also a big “X” splashed\lacross it in red paint…$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
text: DEVON CORPORATION\p“For all your living needs, we make\nit all.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ROXANNE\p“The ROCK-loving honors student!”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeSign
text: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE\p“Access limited to DEVON employees\nand authorized personnel.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
text: RUSTBORO CITY\p“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL\p“We'll teach you anything about\nPOKéMON!”$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
text: CUTTER'S HOUSE$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
text: I've been developing an added feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pAnd it turned out great!\p{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?\nThe one our PRESIDENT gave you?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
text:
There you go, {PLAYER}!\pI added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.\pUsing the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have\lbeen registered in your POKéNAV.\p{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.\pTest it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseSelectPokenav
text: Please select the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork
text: Okay, I'd better get back to work.\nPlease take care, {PLAYER}!$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
text:
Did you know this?\pYou can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.\pIf you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,\lthey'll both challenge you.\pDon't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
text:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…\lAnd your well-trained POKéMON…\pYou're obviously a skilled TRAINER!\pNo, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.\pI'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.\pNo need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
text:
That HM registers CUT as a field
technique for your team.\pWith the STONE BADGE, a party
member able to learn CUT can chop\lthin trees.\pIt needn't keep CUT among its four
battle moves.$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
text: When they were expanding the city of\nRUSTBORO, my dad helped out.\pHe made his POKéMON use CUT to clear\nthe land of trees.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
text: Hello and welcome to the DEVON\nCORPORATION.\pWe're proud producers of items and\nmedicine that enhance your life.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
text: One of our researchers was robbed\nof an important parcel. I hope\lhe's all right.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
text: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!\nThey're one of our products!\pIt makes me happy when I see someone\nusing something we made.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
text: That parcel holds instruments for\nCAPT. STERN's research.\pWho would go to so much trouble\nto steal them? They must know\lwhat the captain is studying.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
text: It sounds like they've recovered\nthe ripped-off DEVON GOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
text: I'm sorry, only authorized people\nare allowed to enter here.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
text: After that robbery, we're being\nmuch more careful with our\lresearch deliveries.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
text: Hi, there!\nYou're always welcome here!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
text:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.\pThere's a panel with some writing
on it…\p“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.\p“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.\p“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.\p“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
text:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.\pThere's a panel with a description…\p“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and\lpharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.\p“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including\lPOKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherOffer
text: DEVON can safely return an evolved\nEEVEE to its original form. Try it?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherChoose
text: Choose the EEVEE evolution to return\nto EEVEE.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherConfirm
text: Return {STR_VAR_1} to EEVEE? Its\ncurrent moves will be preserved.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherComplete
text: The genetic pattern stabilized.\n{STR_VAR_1} is EEVEE again.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherInvalid
text: That POKéMON is not an evolved member\nof EEVEE's family.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeResearcherExit
text: The machine will be ready whenever\nyou need it.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_LegendarySignResearcherIntro
text:
HOENN is full of rare discoveries.
You can find them at your own pace.\pMany legendaries are wild residents
with a 3% encounter chance each.\lRoute signs list them and mark\leach one you catch.\pSWEET SCENT helps find them.\pOther wild discoveries need local
help, story progress or partners.\lThose have 1% chances normally.\lSWEET SCENT gives a shared 25%\lchance among eligible, uncaught\llocal legends.\pRead the area signs for the exact
requirements. Failed encounters\lremain available until caught.\pOthers await you at special places
or come from rewards. Talk to the\lpeople you meet on your travels.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaParty
text: Your discovery completes DEVON's\nsealed mechanical prototype!\pMAGEARNA awakens and joins your party.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaPC
text: Your discovery completes DEVON's\nsealed mechanical prototype!\pMAGEARNA awakens and is sent to\nyour PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaNoRoom
text: The sealed prototype answers DIANCIE,\nbut your party and PC have no room.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardParty
text: You restored HOENN's weather and\nearned all eight badges.\lSomething extraordinary has\lanswered!\pARCEUS appears before you and\njoins your party.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardPC
text: You restored HOENN's weather and\nearned all eight badges.\lSomething extraordinary has\lanswered!\pARCEUS appears before you and is\nsent to your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardNoRoom
text: ARCEUS has answered your journey,\nbut needs room. Please make space\lin your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRewardComplete
text: Even ARCEUS has joined your\njourney. Take your discoveries to\lthe LEAGUE!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
text: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
text: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
text:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
text: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
text:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
text: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
text: My FOSSIL REGENERATOR can restore\nancient POKéMON from every era.\pBring me any complete fossil you find.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
text: Wait! You have a POKéMON fossil!\pShall I restore its ancient POKéMON\nwith the FOSSIL REGENERATOR?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
text: Oh, is that so?\pDEVON's technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ChooseFossil
text: The machine restores one fossil at\na time. Which one shall I revive?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
text: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilNoLongerAvailable
text: Oh! That fossil is no longer in your\nBag. Bring it back and we'll try again.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilDataLost
text: The regenerator's record is unreadable.\nI've reset it so we can try again.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
text:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
text: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pIt was {STR_VAR_2}!\nAn ancient POKéMON!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
text: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
text: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
text: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
text:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_MegaGift_MAGEARNITE_Text
text: Eight badges! You have seen things\nour laboratory can only dream of.\pThis stone responds to Magearna.\nPerhaps you can learn why.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
text:
I'm MR. STONE, president of
DEVON. You recovered our GOODS\land protected my staff. Thank\lyou!\pReports of rare POKéMON are
arriving from caves and forests\lacross HOENN.\pMAGMA and AQUA are searching
those same places. I fear the\lthefts are connected.\pMy son STEVEN is in GRANITE CAVE
near DEWFORD. Please take this\lLETTER to him.\pThen deliver the GOODS to CAPT.
STERN in SLATEPORT. He's counting\lon us.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_LetterSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the\nLETTER was sent to your PC.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_LetterNoRoom
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full.\nMake room, then return to my desk.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
text: Please take this POKéNAV. You'll need\na good map for the journey ahead.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
text: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
text:
The POKéNAV maps HOENN and keeps
you in touch with key Trainers.\pFor legendary leads, visit the
guide near the POKéMON CENTER PC.\pEach town's guide knows nearby
Pokémon and their requirements.\pPlease rest before you leave.
DEWFORD is your next stop.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
text: Go carefully, {PLAYER}. You've already\ndone more for us than I could ask.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
text: You'll find STEVEN in GRANITE\nCAVE near DEWFORD. He loses track\lof time studying rocks!\pFor local legendary leads, ask\nthe guide near the PC in any\lPOKéMON CENTER.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_StevenAwaitsKnuckleBadge
text: STEVEN received my LETTER. Good.\pHe will entrust the MEGA RING\nonly after you earn DEWFORD's\lKNUCKLE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
text: You reached STEVEN and earned the\nright to use MEGA EVOLUTION.\lExcellent.\pThis stone was found above\nRUSTBORO. Let PIDGEOT show you\lwhat it can become.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainPidgeotite
text:
PIDGEOTITE lets a PIDGEOT Mega
Evolve when it holds the stone and\lyou possess a MEGA RING.\pFind Mega Stones in HOENN's caves,
gyms and side paths, or through\lthe people you meet.\pCENTER vendors supply held items
and ordinary evolution items free\lof charge.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
text:
Some rare POKéMON become
available as you earn BADGES or\lhelp HOENN.\pA few also require you to have
caught another POKéMON. Our guide\ltells you exactly which one.\pYou can explore and catch them
without visiting our researcher.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
text:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.\pOur PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.\pAnyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.\pUm… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…\pCould I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?\pIt would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.\pUh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?\pOh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
text: Our PRESIDENT would like to have\na word with you.\pPlease come with me.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
text: Please, go ahead.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
text: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,\nyou should go see CAPT. STERN.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
text: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL\nand TIMER BALL, have become hugely\lpopular among TRAINERS.$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
text: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by the PRESIDENT.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
text: Every POKéMON has a special ability\nthat it can use.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
text: POKéMON are such strange creatures.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
text:
Oh, it's so hard every day…\pWhat's hard?
You need to ask?\pIt's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.\pIt really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
text:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.\pI have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?\pYou see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.\pAnd I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.\pI think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.\pDo you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
text: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”\nto amuse her lately.\pDo you know of a better word or\na phrase that might work?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLetsHearSuggestion
text: Oh, that's wonderful.\nSo, let's hear it, your suggestion.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
text: Oh, is that right?\pWell, if you come up with a good\nsuggestion, I'm all ears.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry2
text: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, yes! She's laughing!\nOh, I am as delighted as she!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry
text: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
text: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI'd better think for myself, then.\pHmm…\nHow about “{STR_VAR_1}”?\lLet's see if that will work.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
text: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI guess I'll try to amuse her with\lthe saying I used before.\pAnyways, if you have a good suggestion,\ndon't hesitate in telling me, okay?$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
text:
Thank you!\pThanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!\pActually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON\lCORPORATION's top researchers.\pSo, how about I do something in return
for you?\pI know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC\lPOKéMON Storage System.\pIn the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”\pThat will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
text: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
text: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in\nthis building.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
text: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just\na teeny, tiny company.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pMy daddy made this!\nBut I can't use it, so you can have it.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to work for\nDEVON, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDadsAceAtDevon
text: My dad is a real ace at DEVON.\pHere. Take something an ACE TRAINER\nlike me knows how to use.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_PokemonHoldFloatStone
text: DEVON refines METAL COATS.\pUse one from the BAG to evolve\nONIX or SCYTHER. No trade with\lanother player is required.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_PutOnWeight
text: For some reason, I've put on a lot of\nweight recently…$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
text: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect\nrare stones.$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
text: I think the PRESIDENT's son also\ncollects rare stones.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GuideIntroduction
text:
Yo! Welcome to RUSTBORO GYM.\pEvery trainer here brings a
complete doubles plan. ROXANNE\lbrings the full force of her Rock\lteam.\pPrepare your partners, study the
board, and make your own opening.\pTake these FRESH WATERS. Come see
me after you earn the BADGE!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
ROXANNE uses Rock Pokémon with
different jobs.\pCARBINK can reverse move order
with TRICK ROOM. NOSEPASS can\lguard its partner from spread\lattacks.\pWater and Grass are useful, but
target choice and timing still\lmatter. Build the answer that\lsuits your team!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!\pGreat!
Check your TRAINER CARD.\pThe STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.\pIn other words…\pYou've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!\pThat's got to feel awesome!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro
text: BONSLY and SHIELDON can survive a\nknockout blow at full health.\pWe make that extra action count!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat
text: Our wall came down!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle
text: STURDY can preserve BONSLY at\nfull health. Chip damage or an\lAbility that bypasses it changes\lthe plan.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro
text: LILEEP drinks the water you aim at\nmy rocks. SHUCKLE slows your feet.\pGo on -- find the dry path!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyDefeat
text: You saw right through them!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
text: Two small ROCKS still add up. Never\nunderestimate a first-badge team.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
text: AMAURA calls snow and raises\nAURORA VEIL.\pStop the screen or find a way\nthrough!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat
text: You kept control of your choices!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
text: ROXANNE combines every lesson: field\ncontrol, reverse speed, and endurance.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
text:
I am ROXANNE, RUSTBORO's GYM
LEADER.\pEach challenger gives me
something new to study.\pMy Pokémon can endure a blow,
guard a partner, or reverse the\lorder of battle.\pShow me how your team answers
mine.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
text: There is always more to learn. Even a\ncarefully prepared team can be beaten.\pYou have earned the STONE BADGE.\nMay it be the first of many!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE\nfrom ROXANNE.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
text:
The STONE BADGE lets your LEVELER
train a party up to Lv. 20.\pIt also enables POKéMON to use
CUT outside of battle.\pIt also marks your first true
step toward the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pPlease take this with you, too.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRoxanneRewards
text: Aerodactylite lets Aerodactyl Mega\nEvolve once you possess a Mega Ring.\pDEVON can restore that OLD AMBER.\nConsider Aerodactyl your first Mega\lproject.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle
text: Your next GYM is BRAWLY's in DEWFORD.\pMR. BRINEY sails from his cottage on\nROUTE 104, south of PETALBURG WOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\pROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}?
This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.\pI heard from BRAWLY that you're
moving up through the ranks of\lTRAINERS at an incredible clip.\pYour progress gives my students
an excellent model to study.\pI hope you'll share what you learn
as your journey continues!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne
text: Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE\nin the POKéNAV.$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
text:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchDefeat
text: Grr…\nAgain, I have lost…$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch
text: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn\nwhen it comes to battling POKéMON.\pThat awareness makes me love battling\nall that much more!$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become…\pOh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with at least one more
POKéMON.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
text:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.\pBut if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.\pI'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
text: Eheheh…\nPlease be good to my POKéMON.\pIt already has a proper battle set,\nso it can fight from day one.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
text: Huh? That doesn't look anything like\na {STR_VAR_1} to me.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
text: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.\nBut my POKéMON is cute, you know…$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
text: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise\nit with care and kindness.$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
text: In all sorts of places, there are all\nsorts of POKéMON and people.\pI find that fascinating, so I go to all\nsorts of places.$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
text: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.\pIf you study there, you could even\nbecome a GYM LEADER.$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
text: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows\na lot about POKéMON.\pShe's really strong, too!$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
text: For my own POKéMON, I give them\nperfectly suited nicknames!\pIt's my expression of, uh…\noriginality, yes, that's it!$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
text: But giving the name PEKACHU to\na PIKACHU? It seems pointless.\pI suppose it is good to use a name\nthat's easy to understand, but…$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
text: PEKACHU: Peka!$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: FALSE SWIPE used to be my special TM.\pThe POKéMON CENTER specialist now\nteaches it whenever it is legal.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
text: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and\nANTIDOTES.\pJust in case I run into SHROOMISH\nin PETALBURG WOODS.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
text: My POKéMON evolved.\nIt has a lot of HP now.\pI should buy SUPER POTIONS for it\ninstead of ordinary POTIONS.$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
text: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in\ncase I get lost in a cave.\pI just need to use it to get back to\nthe entrance.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
text: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my\nfriend's has a JOLLY nature.\pIt's fascinating how POKéMON have\npersonalities!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
text: Just like people, there are male and\nfemale POKéMON.\pBut no one seems to have any idea how\nthey're different.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
text: The man next door gave me CUT!\pWith the STONE BADGE and a\ncompatible partner, I can clear\lskinny trees. It doesn't take up\la battle move slot.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
text: The blackboard lists status changes\nthat may affect POKéMON in battle.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
text: Which topic do you want to read?$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
text: If a POKéMON is poisoned, it steadily\nloses HP during battle.\pPoison remains after battle, but it no\nlonger causes damage while traveling.\pHeal it using an ANTIDOTE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
text:
If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.\pIt may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.\pParalysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
text: Sleep prevents most moves until\nthe Pokémon wakes.\pSLEEP TALK and SNORE are\nexceptions. A sleeping Pokémon\lstays asleep after battle;\lAWAKENING cures it.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
text:
A burn normally lowers damage from
physical attacks and causes HP\lloss.\pSome Abilities change that result.
GUTS attackers can benefit from\lburn!\pBURN HEAL removes a burn outside a
trainer battle.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
text: A frozen Pokémon usually cannot\nmove. It may thaw, and certain\lmoves can help it thaw as well.\pFreezing remains after battle. An\nICE HEAL removes it.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoStudyEveryTool
text: A good TRAINER studies every\ntool.\pThis SUN STONE evolves certain\nPOKéMON. Show me that you know\lwhen to use it.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSunStone
text: A Sun Stone evolves certain Pokémon.\nUse it from the Bag when ready.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
text: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend\nright now.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
text: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and\nI'm finally getting one!$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
text: POKéMON can hold items, but they\ndon't know what to do with man-made\litems like POTION and ANTIDOTE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
text:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?\pA confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.\pBut once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
text:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…\pThere are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…\pBoy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
text:
It's this student's notebook…\pPOKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.\pUp to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.\pA TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles\lwith them.\pA TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await\lchallengers in POKéMON GYMS.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
text:
SCOTT: We met in PETALBURG, didn't
we? I'm looking for exceptional\lTrainers.\pThe CUTTER nearby has the CUT HM.
Collect it and the STONE BADGE.\pThen a compatible party member can
clear thin trees without keeping\lCUT in its battle moves.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
text: SCOTT: Hmm…\pThe talent levels of the students here\nare unknown. The potential's there.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
text:
SCOTT: Oh, what's that?\pIt's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
text:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pOh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?\pThat's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$
